title.ja: H/Heの式・密度・固定参照カード
title.en: Hydrogenic formulas and immutable finite-basis helium reference cards

cards.model_scope: Three saved 40-function He reference rows, hydrogenic analytic equations, p versus n and finite-grid/basis/model limits.

main_figure.basis: Figure contract: use saved numerical arrays; reference-only panels use unchanged stored values.

unimplemented_or_unverified_tails: No new SCF, external-reference regeneration, complete-basis or correlated-exact helium claim.

reference_cards.model: One electron, infinite-mass point nucleus, nonrelativistic isolated Coulomb Hamiltonian.
reference_cards.conventions: Atomic units hbar=me=e=4piepsilon0=1; energy hartree, radius bohr; Psi=R_nl(r)Y_lm, u=rR; integral|u|²dr=1 with normalized angular function.
formulas: u(0)=0; physical u(r)->0 as r->infinity; finite release imposes u(rmax)=0
reference_cards.degeneracy: Energy independent of l,m for fixedn; orbital degeneracy n² ignoring spin,2n² including two spin labels; radial release samples selected l, not all magnetic states.
reference_cards.limits: Analytic continuum energies/orbitals are distinct from finite radial grid and Dirichlet-box errors.

formula_conventions_r2.radial_polynomial_degree: k=n-l-1 (DLMF uses p for this degree; do not confuse it with the radial electron density p(r)).
formula_conventions_r2.released_source_equivalence: Substitute r=n*rho/(2Z) into atomic_radial.py53–65. Its r*(2Z/n)^(3/2)*sqrt((n-l-1)!/[2n(n+l)!])*rho^l coefficient reduces to the u formula above; this is an authored algebraic correspondence, not a new numerical check.
formula_conventions_r2.new_official_selected_support: DLMF18.39 HTML equations26–35 and nearby measure/quantum-number text were read in R2; no TeX/PDF image reading claimed.

reference_cards.model: Spherical closed-shell1s² restricted HF; one doubly occupied spatial orbital, not correlated exactHe.
formulas: v_eff=-2/r+v_H/2; E_x=-E_H/2 only for this one-orbital two-electron model
reference_cards.limits: HF exchange cancellation is a special helium reduction; not general local exchange.

density_conventions_r2.spatial_orbital: Psi(r,angles)=u(r)Y00/r with Y00=1/sqrt(4pi); one spatial orbital occupied twice.
density_conventions_r2.finite_grid: Published solver uses positive interior r_i and dr*sum(u_i²)=1, dr*sum(p_i)=2 with zero Dirichlet endpoints; it is not a claim of exact continuum normalization.
density_conventions_r2.origin: n(0) is a regular limiting value; do not divide a sampled r=0 by r². Released grid has positive interior radii.
density_conventions_r2.energy: Orbital eigenvalue and many-electron total energy are separately labeled; neither HF nor LDA_X total energy is correlated exactHe.

reference_cards.model: Spin-unpolarized exchange-only local density functional, not LDA+VWN/PBE and not correlated exactHe.
reference_cards.limits: Numerical agreement certifies only fixed-model finite discretizations, not physical accuracy.
